article.story: LYNCHBURG, Va. -- — Kaden Metheny scored 22 points to help Liberty defeat Jacksonville State 78-69 on Sunday. Metheny shot 7 for 13 (5 for 9 from 3-point range) and 3 of 3 from the free-throw line for the Flames (11-3, 3-0 Conference USA). Brett Decker Jr. added 16 points and Colin Porter scored 13. The Gamecocks (7-7, 2-1) were led in scoring by Emondrek Erkins-Ford, who finished with 24 points and two blocks. Jacksonville State also got 22 points from Anthony Bryant. Mostapha El Moutaouakkil had eight points and eight rebounds. Porter's 3-pointer with 19:14 remaining in the second half gave Liberty the lead for good at 30-27. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
